description: What an address can collect from coins, with UNSIGNED claim transactions (send them from that address): holder dividends of coins with a creator vault (USDC for USDC-paired coins, the pair token for v3 coins; released over 24 hours after each harvest and withdrawn from the coin itself), the address's creator-side earnings in each coin's vault (as its creator or a split recipient), and creator revenue of coins launched before vaults (in the FeeEscrow, USDC). Without coins it checks the coins the address holds or launched (up to 50); pass coins to check others, such as coins where it is only a split recipient. Vaults are harvested automatically. Amounts are human units; fields ending in Raw are smallest units.

coins.description: Coins to check, up to 50; default the coins the wallet holds or launched

name: get_coin_earnings
